modules.name: Death's Hand
modules.description: An evil complex oscillator: through-zero FM, wavefolder, AM/ring, self-feedback, chaos cross-FM and a Lorenz modulator. Same DSP as the patch.Init firmware.

modules.name: Doombringer
modules.description: A ladder filter that summons what isn't there: self-oscillation in tune, a resonance that folds and bends its own cutoff, undertones an octave and two below the input, an envelope that feeds the cutoff, and a ping. Same DSP as the patch.Init firmware.
